dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go with this one, this one... and this one. These are all pretty old, huh... Hey, we're buying so many. You can give us a discount, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: And throw those two at the back into the bundle too. C'monnn, you've put them out for ages, and nobody's bought them anyway! We'll give them a home at half-off, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Eh, no biggie. It's just a few fairy tale books. Easy-peasy! Plus, with me around, you can be sure you're not getting ripped off.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: But, dude, seriously, what are you gonna do with all these? Read 'em yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Durin
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm! I also want to bring them to Hat Guy. He probably hasn't read these books either.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, you two really get along, huh. These books are all packed — here, take 'em. I've got some things to take care of, so I'll head off now.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Thanking me once is enough... *cough* Anyway, I'm going. Catch you next time.
